test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Smart Bazaar is offering 'Buy 2, Get 8 free' on household items. What is the net percentage discount being offered by the Smart Bazaar?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Buy 2, get 8 free ⇒ total items = 10, pay for 2

Effective cost per item = 2/10 = 1/5 of MRP

Discount = 1 − 1/5 = 4/5

= 80%

**∴ Answer = 80% discount**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Buy 2 items and get 8 items free

**Formula used:**

Discount % = (Free items ÷ Total items) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total items received = 2 + 8 = 10

⇒ Cost is paid only for 2 items

⇒ Free items = 8

⇒ Discount % = (8 ÷ 10) × 100

⇒ = 80%

**∴ The correct answer is 80%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equivalent Discount

Buy x get y free ⇒ Discount = y/(x+y) × 100

Effective Price

Effective price per item = Paid items ÷ Total items

Profit/Loss View

Such offers reduce effective selling price per unit.

Quick Trick

Discount = Free ÷ Total × 100
